subject: general
question: Diesel fuel is generally used in which of the following types of vehicles?
solution:
The correct answer is __Heavy trucks and buses.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diesel fuel__ is widely used in heavy-duty vehicles such as trucks and buses.
 
• It is chosen for these vehicles due to its higher energy efficiency and better fuel economy.
 
• Diesel engines are designed to produce higher torque which is crucial for heavy-duty transportation.
 
• Diesel engines have a longer lifespan and are more durable, making them suitable for commercial vehicles.
 
• Environmental regulations are pushing advancements in cleaner diesel technologies to reduce emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cars:**

 
 
• Many cars also run on diesel fuel, particularly larger ones or those designed for long-distance travel.
 
• Diesel cars often have better mileage compared to petrol cars.
 
 
 
• **Scooters:**
 
 
• Diesel is not commonly used in scooters; they typically run on petrol or electric power.
 
 
 
• **Aerospace Vehicles:**
 
 
• Aerospace vehicles generally use specialized fuels such as aviation gasoline (Avgas) or jet fuel, not diesel.
